boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Louis University
boards.description: Late food options with published current hours; confirm availability before heading out.

cards.title: Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe — SLU Campus
cards.subtitle: 3722 Laclede Ave, on SLU's campus
cards.notes: Order ahead or stop in at the Laclede Avenue location. The restaurant publishes daily service through 2 a.m.; check its ordering page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A campus-address late option with published daily 2 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickleman's official SLU Campus page lists 3722 Laclede Avenue and hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10 a.m.–2 a.m. daily. Verify service availability before traveling.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza — Laclede Ave
cards.subtitle: 3822 Laclede Ave, beside SLU
cards.notes: Use carryout or delivery from the Laclede Avenue store. Published carryout runs until 12:40 a.m. most nights and 1:40 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Laclede Avenue pizza stop with late published carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists this store at 3822 Laclede Ave; carryout ends at 12:40 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:40 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published carryout: until 12:40 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 1:40 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Delivery runs later on listed days.

cards.title: Up Late — Vandeventer Location
cards.subtitle: 1904 S Vandeventer Ave
cards.notes: Plan this as a Thursday–Sunday run and review the menu or ordering options first. The business lists its Vandeventer location with 8 p.m.–4 a.m. hours.
cards.short_summary: A late-hours food destination with service listed until 4 a.m. Thursday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Up Late's official site lists its Vandeventer location at 1904 S Vandeventer Ave and states Thursday–Sunday hours of 8 p.m.–4 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Thursday–Sunday, 8 p.m.–4 a.m. Confirm ordering and service format before departure.

cards.title: Taco Bell — N Kingshighway
cards.subtitle: 626 N Kingshighway Blvd, Central West End
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to check drive-thru timing before going. It identifies this Saint Louis restaurant as open late, with service listed through 4 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A nearby chain location with published 4 a.m. late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's Saint Louis location listing identifies the restaurant at 626 N Kingshighway Blvd as open until 4 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Saint Louis, MO
cards.access_notes: The official Saint Louis listing reports this location open until 4 a.m.; confirm dine-in versus drive-thru service before visiting.

cards.title: Taco Bell — South Grand
cards.subtitle: 3501 S Grand Ave, South Grand
cards.notes: Check the location’s current service mode before you leave. The official Saint Louis listing marks the South Grand restaurant as open late and lists it through 4 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A South Grand option with late service listed to 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Saint Louis location listing identifies the restaurant at 3501 S Grand Ave as open until 4 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Saint Louis, MO
cards.access_notes: The official Saint Louis listing reports this location open until 4 a.m.; verify available service before traveling.

cards.title: Taco Bell — South Kingshighway
cards.subtitle: 3440 S Kingshighway Blvd
cards.notes: If using the drive-thru, check the store page on the day of travel. Published hours run to 3 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Kingshighway late option with different published hours by day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page for 3440 S Kingshighway lists drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and until 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — Dinner Near Me at 3440 S Kingshighway
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru: until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; until 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. The page separately lists dine-in hours.

cards.title: Imo's Pizza — St. Louis Downtown
cards.subtitle: 904 S 4th St, downtown Saint Louis
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order through the downtown store. Its published schedule runs through midnight most nights and 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Imo's location with midnight-to-1 a.m. published service.
cards.evidence_claim: Imo's official downtown store page lists 904 S 4th St and hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; delivery hours match the listed schedule.

cards.title: City Diner
cards.subtitle: 3139 S Grand Blvd, Tower Grove South
cards.notes: Use the contact page to confirm the weekend schedule before heading south. City Diner lists all-night service on Fridays and Saturdays, with Sunday closing at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A South Grand diner that publishes all-night Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: City Diner's official contact page lists 3139 S Grand Blvd and says it is open all night Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Published hours state the diner is open all night Fridays and Saturdays; Monday–Thursday hours end at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Padrinos Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 3143 S Grand Blvd, Tower Grove South
cards.notes: Plan for Friday or Saturday and confirm kitchen availability by phone or online before travel. The restaurant publishes late-night hours from 10 p.m. to 1 a.m. on those nights.
cards.short_summary: A South Grand restaurant with Friday–Saturday late-night service listed to 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Padrinos' official site lists 3143 S Grand Blvd and states it is open late night Friday and Saturday from 10 p.m.–1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published late-night hours: Friday and Saturday, 10 p.m.–1 a.m. Confirm current food service before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell — Skinker
cards.subtitle: 851 N Skinker Blvd, near the Delmar Loop
cards.notes: Use the official store page to check the day’s service details before leaving. Published drive-thru hours run until 3 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Skinker location with published drive-thru availability into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page for 851 N Skinker Blvd lists drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and until 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru: until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; until 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Check current dine-in availability separately.
